caption: The drawing depicts a pair of andirons, each designed with a sculptural representation of a seated dog or similar animal on top. Both andirons are colored in shades of brown, giving them a metallic appearance that suggests they could be made of cast iron or bronze. The animal figures sit upright, facing slightly outward and to the right. The base of each andiron is ornate, consisting of a detailed, curving design with a central motif and two splayed legs that provide visual stability. A horizontal bar extends from the back of each base, completing the functional form of the andirons. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the objects without distraction. There is a small signature that reads "Rose Bush" in the bottom right corner.
title: Fire Dogs
